question: In fdot-aadt-us19-sr55-pasco-hernando.csv, estimate daily truck volume per segment as AADT x TFCTR / 100. Summed over all segments of COUNTY Pasco with AADT of at least 5000, what is the estimated total daily truck volume, rounded to 1 decimal?
solve_py:
import os,pandas as pd
D=os.environ.get('DATA_DIR','/app/data')
d=pd.read_csv(D+'/fdot-aadt-us19-sr55-pasco-hernando.csv')
d=d[(d.COUNTY=='Pasco')&(d.AADT>=5000)]
print(round(float((d.AADT*d.TFCTR/100).sum()),1))
